newsitem.title: USA: Martin Marietta Materials adopts shareholder rights.
newsitem.headline: Martin Marietta Materials adopts shareholder rights.

text.p: Martin Marietta Materials Inc said Tuesday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan in which preferred stock purchase rights will be distributed as a dividend at a rate of one right for each share of common stock.
The record date for the dividend distribution is the close of business October 21, as long as Lockheed Martin Corp completes its pending splitoff of the company by then.
The rights are to expire on October 21, 2006.
Martin Marietta said the rights plan is intended to allow shareholders to realize the long-term value of their investment in the company.
The company said the rights will not prevent a takeover but should encourage anyone seeking to acquire it to negotiate beforehand with the board.
Each right would entitle shareholders, under certain circumstances, to buy 1/1000th of a newly issued Class A preferred stock share at an exercise price of $100.
The rights would be exercisable if an individual or group acquired 15 percent or more of the company's common stock, or made a tender offer to own 15 percent or more of the company's common stock.

Martin Marietta will be allowed to redeem the rights at $0.01 per right at any time until the 10th day following public disclosure that a person or group had acquired 15 percent or more of its common stock.
Lockheed holds an 81 percent interest in Martin Marietta.
